verdict.rationale: MailerSend's pricing page documents a free trial that grants access to all Professional plan features before subscribing. Professional is a production sending plan, which implies real sending during evaluation. However, the evidence never states trial volumes, recipient restrictions, or duration, so it is unproven whether the trial allows unrestricted real deliveries to your own users. One community report of an account being denied without explanation is a single anecdote and does not concretely contradict the trial. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that trial or free sends reach arbitrary real recipients, documented trial or free-tier quotas and duration, any recipient or domain-verification restrictions during trial, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can integrate and validate the service on a free tier or trial that allows real deliveries to my own users, not just a demo

citations.quote: Start your free trial and get access to all Professional plan features, then subscribe to a plan when you’re ready.
